status: construction_contract; separate complete scoped gate required
selection: one fixed SIGTERM through proc_signal_with_audittoken after identity and executable joins
authority: The trusted supervisor establishes an active sampled descendant through OwnedTree.
The supervisor selects the exact frozen distinct renderer executable; the helper does not discover or authorize descendants.
The helper rejoins PID, birth, parent PID, effective UID, real UID, live status, token identity, and exact executable path.
A successful signal syscall reports signal acceptance only. It supplies no process retirement, application cleanup, scientific, or release authority.

approaches.approach: numeric PID signal after userspace checks
approaches.assumption: the PID still denotes the checked process at signal time
approaches.failure_mode: PID reuse or identity change remains between check and signal
approaches.decisive_control: stale kernel identity must be rejected without affecting the replacement

approaches.assumption: every group member is an intended target
approaches.failure_mode: the renderer fault becomes a broad application fault
approaches.decisive_control: unrelated owner and body processes must remain unaffected

approaches.assumption: the runtime can add and qualify a new fault contract
approaches.benefit: the runtime identifies its own renderer
approaches.failure_mode: changes the frozen application and protocol surface
approaches.decisive_control: source and protocol compatibility would require a separate milestone

approaches.approach: terminate through a task control port
approaches.assumption: stronger Mach task control is available and appropriate
approaches.failure_mode: broader authority and different termination behavior

approaches.approach: audit-token version comparison with fixed SIGTERM
approaches.assumption: the selected SDK and kernel implement audit-token identity comparison
approaches.benefit: kernel checks the selected process version during signal dispatch
approaches.failure_mode: API denial, stale token, or lost output makes the experiment fail or remain uncertain
approaches.decisive_control: wrong-version ESRCH with surviving owned child, exact-token positive, API anomaly controls, and output-loss control

selected_reason: The last approach preserves one renderer target and one signal without changing the application. Owner selection remains a separate prerequisite.
failure_semantics: Malformed arguments and failed pre-signal joins make zero signal calls.
Null or dead task-name ports, token-size mismatch, port-release failure, changed token input, and malformed path output fail before signal.
A nonzero signal result fails the command. No numeric-PID fallback or retry is authorized.
Output can fail after a successful signal. A nonzero or unavailable command result therefore does not prove that no signal was delivered.
The supervisor must retain uncertainty and obtain separate owner receipts; it must never retry an ambiguous fault automatically.
limits: These interfaces come from the installed macOS SDK; libproc marks its interface surface as private and subject to OS changes.
The tested OS and SDK do not qualify another Darwin version or platform.
A path join does not attest loaded executable bytes. The helper is not a malicious-code or complete descendant-containment boundary.
The helper alone can inspect a caller-selected same-user identity. Safe selection depends on the trusted supervisor contract.
The syscall result does not prove signal handling, process exit, reaping, or application cleanup.

source_observations.observation: The wrapper returns the syscall error for token-bound signaling. Token-bound path lookup requests a PID-version comparison.
Kernel dispatch copies the audit token and routes the requested signal through audit-token signaling.
Audit-token process lookup compares the process PID version; process identity validation distinguishes permission to exec.

evidence_boundary: Public source review explains the design. Actual installed-kernel controls and exact source/compiler receipts qualify only their recorded scope.

lenses.scientific: A process fault is engineering evidence, not a neuroscience or reproduction result.
lenses.runtime: Signal acceptance, command response, process disappearance, reaping, and application retirement remain separate facts.
lenses.security_provenance: Source and SDK hashes bind the local construction; the trusted supervisor retains target selection authority.
lenses.generalization: Owned synthetic children do not qualify a real Chrome renderer, hostile code, or unobserved descendants.
lenses.maintainability: One small SDK-built helper and explicit negative controls replace no existing application owner or protocol.
